about: What each feature has shown, one claim a column. tools/release/capability_matrix.py checks these rows and writes them as the table in docs/verification.md; `make docs` runs it. A cell is a status, alone or followed by a colon and what it rests on. A yes or partial for a GPU run or a measurement needs a record under evidence/ in the row's records.

statuses.yes: shown, by the test or record the cell or the row names
statuses.partial: part of it shown; the cell says which part
statuses.no: not shown: it has not compiled, run or been measured for this tree
statuses.n/a: the claim does not apply to this feature
